Synopsis:
Former French Prime Minister Edouard Balladur, a centre-right technocrat who served under President Mitterrand (1993–1995), has died aged 97. He is remembered for a major privatisation program (Société Générale, Paribas, TF1) and a 1993 pension reform. Tributes from current PM Lecornu highlight his legacy as a reformist statesman.
